stages.name: 固定範圍
stages.exitEvidence: schema 可拒絕錯誤；版本與未知項可追蹤

stages.name: 技術骨架
stages.exitEvidence: headless tick、命令、snapshot、重播 hash；完整 sim/Worker 邊界
stages.foundationGate: passed: fixed ticks, command validation, save/replay, path budget, Worker recovery, resource atomicity
stages.remainingIntegration: Gameplay-specific production, technology, combat and vision checks will be implemented with C-E; not claimed complete.

stages.name: 積木視覺與戰場
stages.exitEvidence: 3D 模型、資源與迷霧實際可見
stages.note: C 的地形、資源、迷霧、城鎮中心入口與模型已有實證；剩餘為美術元件庫／細節矩陣（美術待辦）與需 E 施工、送返才有意義的作業區，刻意延後，不標記完成。

stages.name: 基本操作
stages.exitEvidence: 框選、編組、路徑、狹道與 HUD 實測
stages.note: D 的選取、框選、編組、群體移動、單位占位、窄道與鏡頭平移已有實證（first-use-008、009）；攻擊移動、巡邏、跟隨、佇列路點、隊形朝向、小地圖與完整 HUD 需要 E 的戰鬥與生產才有意義，刻意延後，不標記完成。

stages.name: 首個完整對局
stages.exitEvidence: 經濟→升級→造兵→攻城→勝敗→再開局
stages.note: Two-side vertical slice: economy, farms, age 2, militia/archers, scout, siege, conquest or resignation, new game, played end to end through the UI (tests/first-use-full.mjs) and against the computer (tests/first-use-match.mjs). Open: healing needs monks (stage F), real-GPU frame time unmeasured, the computer is basic (no retreat, concedes early), ages 3-4 have no content.

stages.name: 系統擴充
stages.exitEvidence: 海運、貿易、宗教、文明與完整 AI 實際互動

stages.name: 可恢復遊戲
stages.exitEvidence: 中途存讀續跑、壞檔與重播一致

stages.name: 多人
stages.exitEvidence: 多個真實客戶端、權威伺服器、重连與一局完成

stages.name: 完整品質與規模
stages.exitEvidence: 內容矩陣、音效、美術、相容性及目標硬體量測

releaseGate: E must pass a real full match and prompt 19 before any playable RTS completion claim
